sysConfig.title: Advanced parameters
sysConfig.description: Key/value parameters; changes apply immediately, no release needed
sysConfig.name: Name

upload.title: Upload limits
upload.description: Leave empty or 0 for no limit; the client pre-checks files against these values
upload.unlimitedWarning: Upload size is unlimited; the disk may fill up
upload.allowedTypesHint: Only the listed types can be uploaded
upload.webpHint: The original is kept; a WebP copy is stored alongside and served to browsers that support it. GIF / SVG are not converted.

user_default_password.name: Initial user password
user_default_password.remark: Used when creating users and resetting passwords

login_captcha_enabled.name: Login captcha
login_captcha_enabled.remark: On: a captcha is required for every sign-in. Off: only required after repeated failures

security_ip_whitelist.name: IP allowlist
security_ip_whitelist.remark: Applies to platform administrator endpoints only
